notes.title: Update 1.0.1 (Minor Update)
notes.notes:
In this update, I’ve added two new features:



- The "Restart" button: now visible in the menu. Unlike the "R" key, which sends you back to the last checkpoint, this button restarts the game from the very beginning and also resets the timer.



- A timer: it shows how long you've been playing, which will be useful for those interested in speedrunning.





Several bugs have also been fixed:



- FPS display issues

- Collision bugs with certain objects

- Checkpoint return problems near the end of the game

- Visual glitch in the main menu



This update is a bit light — there aren’t many changes, but the two new features already make the game a bit better. I hope to release a major update in the future.
